title: Re-imagining Watch Experience on Big Screens
subtitle: Leading CTV design for Jiohotstar to enhance viewer experience

hero.alt: Streaming television interface displayed on a teal design board

body.text: Designing for big screens meant rethinking the viewer experience from the living room outward. The goal was to help people discover, choose, and return to the stories they love with greater ease and confidence.

I mapped the television journey across browsing, focused viewing, and quick re-entry moments. The resulting system created a clearer content hierarchy, a more generous viewing canvas, and predictable navigation that worked comfortably from a distance.

closing: The system gave the product a quieter, more intentional rhythm—keeping content discovery visible while preserving the joy of watching together.
